steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 1 problem in 13 items
details: The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation rationale: it says "data on debt and equity financing activities", which the quoted sentences don't show.

steps.title: Critic sent 1 finding back for repair
details: Rational capital allocation: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).

steps.title: Rationale rewrite for rational capital allocation: 383 tokens in, 46 out, ~$0.0002 at paid rates
details: The model saw only the question, the verdict and the quoted sentences, and rewrote the rationale to say no more than they show.

New rationale: The filing identifies that management uses cash for capital and investment expenditures, debt repayment, and shareholder dividends. It further provides a quantified breakdown of total capital, investment, and acquisition expenditures.
